content: रोह {%a.%} [रुह्-अच्] .²1 Growing, springing up. .²2 Rising, ascending. .²3 Riding on; as in अश्वरोहः ‘a rider’. .{@-हः@} .²1 Rising, height, altitude. .²2 The raising of anything (as of a number from a smaller to a higher denomination). .²3 Growth, development (<ab>fig.</ab>). .²4 Bud, blossom, shoot; बीजं चैकं रोहसहस्रमेति <ls>Mb. 12. 120. 38</ls>. .²5 The generating cause; क्षिते रोहः प्रवहः शश्वदेव <ls>Mb. 13. 76. 10</ls>. .²6 A rider; बाणाक्षिप्तारोहशून्यासनानाम् <ls>Śi. 18. 56</ls>.
